subject: reasoning
question:
E, X, P, A, N, and D live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor is numbered as 1 and the topmost floor is numbered as 6. Only one person lives above D. Only A lives below P. E lives on an even numbered floor. X lives on a floor above D.

How many people live below N?
solution:
Given: E, X, P, A, N, and D live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on, till the topmost floor is numbered 6.

1) Only one person lives above D.

2) Only A lives below P.

3) X lives on a floor above D.
